messages:
lena (Partnerships): Partner sync Thursday. Need exact inputs for cost model: reserved vs spot allocation, marketplace fee treatment, and how onboarding credits are applied.
omar (Finance): Do we have their preferred allocation? They mentioned a flexible band but no numbers.
ana (Sales): They floated 55/45 reserved/spot for Q1 in the slide, onboarding credits applied to reserved only. Verbal only.
viv (SRE): Ops needs per-region eviction profiles. If spot evictions exceed ~12% repeatedly, we should pause auto-reserve conversions in that region.
lena (Partnerships): Proposal: damping rule - pause conversions when week-over-week eviction rises >10% and auto-resume after 2 stable weeks. Raise to finance + partnerships.
omar (Finance): Agreed. Also need marketplace fee by SKU. If fees apply only to reserved SKUs, unit economics flip. Request CSV: sku,region,reserved_monthly_usd,spot_hourly_usd,mkt_fee_pct,eviction_30d,commit_weeks_to_full. Need Wed EOD.
ana (Sales): I'll follow up. Also confirm: credits reserved-only? Partner prefers that. Sales want clear language for AE pitch.
sam (Legal): If credits limited to reserved we must reflect that in contract/invoice. I'll draft an addendum and a short SLA credit template.
viv (SRE): Ops note: ensure conversion is atomic relative to routing and billing flags to avoid double-billing. Add a conversion marker in billing pipeline.
ops-bot: note: feature-flag "partner_spot_damping_v2" created in staging. Use /ops deploy to promote.
omar (Finance): I'll run modeling for three mixes: conservative 40% reserved, baseline 60%, aggressive 80%. Overlay marketplace fees at 0%, 5%, 10% and include eviction volatility in Monte Carlo.
lena (Partnerships): Can you output per-SKU CSV by Thu noon? Fields: sku,scenario,reserved_hours_month,spot_hours_month,avg_unit_cost_usd,mkt_fee_usd,variance_note.
omar (Finance): Yes, will include marketplace_fee_abs_usd column for sales clarity.
ana (Sales): Sales wants a one-paragraph ARR impact blurb per scenario for AE playbook. One-pager after the model.
sam (Legal): Partner requested a 24hr "graceful eviction" notice on reserved conversions. Counterproposal: 72hrs minimum; I'll circulate language.
viv (SRE): 72hrs better for autoscaler tuning. Also ask partner to provide historical eviction CSV sample we can ingest: sku,region,eviction_rate_30d,median_recovery_minutes,preemptible_window.
lena (Partnerships): Adding those fields to the CSV ask and commit_weeks_to_full.
ops-bot: reminder set: partner_csv_deadline at 2198700000 (Wed 09:00 UTC).
lena (Partnerships): Actions: 1) Lena: send CSV spec to partner by EOD Wed. 2) Omar: deliver Monte Carlo CSV Thu 12:00. 3) Viv: ops gating checklist + ensure flag safe. 4) Sam: draft addendum + SLA credit clause. 5) Ana: sales one-pager after model.
lena (Partnerships): Anything else?
viv (SRE): Include a capacity ramp timeline field (weeks to full commit). Helps autoscaler and SRE runbook.
lena (Partnerships): Done. I'll post the CSV template here when sent. :rocket:
